summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, reporting a disclosure made to Indian stock exchanges regarding an email from its subsidiary ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company. The email notes a press release by joint venture partner Prudential Corporation Holdings about acquiring a controlling stake in Bharti Life Insurance. ICICI Bank states it intends to retain its majority shareholding in ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company, reaffirming commitment. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of a strategic stance; it does not constitute a transaction, event, or special situation as defined. No terms, recommendations, or structural mechanics are provided. This is a foreign issuer report with no US-equivalent special situation.
